definitions.explanation: In a manner that shows skill and efficiency, getting things done smoothly without wasted effort.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。

⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{分|わ}けて→切り分ける：11774_kiriwakeru⟧いく⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見入|みい}った→見入る：16142_miiru⟧。
examples.english: I was captivated watching the experienced chef deftly cut and portion the ingredients.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (to be skillful/efficient). ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧ literally means "hand skill" or "dexterity" — the ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ form turns it into an adverb meaning "in a skilled manner." Implies practiced, smooth execution without hesitation or wasted motion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧: to handle skillfully
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to handle/process deftly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: skillfully — more general, less emphasis on efficiency
- ⟦{要領|ようりょう}よく→要領よく：24537_youryouyoku⟧: efficiently — emphasizes getting to the point, knowing the tricks
- ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: dexterously — focuses on manual skill
- {手早|てばや}く: quickly and efficiently — emphasizes speed
